articles.summary: Forestar Group Inc. announced today that the Company will release financial results for its second quarter ended March 31, 2025 on Thursday, April 17, 2025 before the market opens. A replay of the call will be available after 3:00 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 17, 2025 at 877-481-4010. When calling, please reference
articles.title: Forestar Group Inc. to Release 2025 Second Quarter Earnings on April 17, 2025
